video_title: The Sixers Vets Won't Be Able to Play Every Game | Chris Mannix & Grant Liffmann

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: The Sixers' offense will be a work in progress with overlapping skill sets
quotes.excerpt: it's very much going to be a work in progress

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Mannix
text_blocks.text: You can tell from hearing from Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, and Nick Nurse, it's very much going to be a work in progress. They have a bunch of guys whose skills overlap. Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, Joel Embiid, these are high-post type of guys offensively. Neither of them play with a big like Joel Embiid, who needs to get touches in the paint. There's going to be a lot to figure out.

text_blocks.speaker: Grant Liffmann
text_blocks.text: There's definitely going to be some clunky stuff. The spotlight is going to be so great on them. We're going to be searching for everything. There's going to be some late-minute game stuff where everyone's going to be like, is it going to LeBron, is it going to Jaylen Brown, how about Maxey, how about Embiid? Everyone's going to be searching for these things.

quotes.speaker: Grant Liffmann
quotes.summary_phrase: The Sixers' success depends heavily on Joel Embiid's health
quotes.excerpt: you can't just talk about the Sixers without saying a lot of it depends on Embiid's health
quotes.quote: You can't just talk about the Sixers without saying a lot of it depends on Embiid's health. It just is the fact of the matter. If you can have Embiid out there for a lot of the season to get that chemistry right, then by the time playoffs happen, you feel good and he's playing. But if he's going to miss a huge part of the season and then come back for the playoffs, then the chemistry gets thrown off one more time.

quotes.speaker: Grant Liffmann
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey is the key to the Sixers' success
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey is the key to this whole thing in my mind
quotes.quote: The wild card about all this is I'm just such a huge Tyrese Maxey fan, and he is getting better and better every year. The energy that he brings to a game, we're going to talk about LeBron, we're going to focus on Jaylen Brown, Embiid's health, but Tyrese Maxey is the key to this whole thing in my mind. This guy is a guy who could play at an MVP type level without these guys there.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey is poised to take a big leap
quotes.excerpt: he is the ascendant star on that roster
quotes.quote: I agree with you on Maxey. He is the ascendant star on that roster. He is the guy that is poised to take a big leap or should be poised to take a big leap, and he's going to be the engine I think that drives a lot of the success in Philadelphia.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid needs to show he can still dominate in the post
quotes.excerpt: I got to see if his lateral movement is what it was
quotes.quote: I'm seeing a lot of the slimmed down Embiid, happy Embiid, healthy Embiid. I got to see it on the floor. I got to see if his lateral movement is what it was so we can be the same monster he was defensively because they need that. I got to see if he's embracing going into the post. You know in recent years he would just drift and drift and drift.

quotes.speaker: Grant Liffmann
quotes.summary_phrase: The Sixers have multiple players who can take over games
quotes.excerpt: they have innings eaters on this team
quotes.quote: The one other part about it is unlike other Embiid teams, and even some LeBron teams recently, they have innings eaters on this team. Maxey, Jaylen Brown, V.J. Edgecombe, these guys are going to eat innings and they're going to win you some games throughout the regular season too. That gives them a chance to be a little bit more rested when the playoffs come.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Nurse is managing the load for aging stars
quotes.excerpt: Nick Nurse is already talking about the load management of his two older more fragile stars
quotes.quote: Joel Embiid is not going to play back-to-backs. LeBron may miss a lot of back-to-backs. Nick Nurse is already talking about the load management of his two older more fragile stars. So there's going to be plenty of opportunity during the regular season for guys like V.J. Edgecombe to continue. I don't want to see him get lost in the shuffle. That kid is really good.
